mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user_identities ( id, user_id, provider, provider_subject, external_did, verified_at, metadata, password_hash, password_changed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{identityId}, #{userId}, 'LOCAL', #{normalizedEmail}, NULL, #{createdAt}, NULL, #{passwordHash}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, provider_subject, password_hash, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_user_identities WHERE provider = 'LOCAL' AND provider_subject = #{normalizedEmail} AND password_hash IS NOT NULL
SELECT id, user_id, provider_subject, password_hash, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_user_identities WHERE provider = 'LOCAL' AND user_id = #{userId} AND password_hash IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user_identities SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_changed_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE provider = 'LOCAL' AND user_id = #{userId} AND password_hash IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT TRUE AS has_local, password_changed_at FROM tb_user_identities WHERE provider = 'LOCAL' AND user_id = #{userId} AND password_hash IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user_identities SET password_changed_at = NULL WHERE provider = 'LOCAL' AND user_id = #{userId} AND password_hash IS NOT NULL
